desc: Parse input; build list of bad intervals; compute free gaps: [1, L_1-1], [R_i+1, L_{i+1}-1], [R_M+1, N].
Implement a reachability simulator using an integer bitmask `mask` of size B bits; define step function (reachable iff any bit j in [A-1, B-1] set; mask = ((mask << 1) | r) & full).
Handle bad segments: if length ≥ B reset mask to 0, else simulate forced-0 steps.
Handle free gaps: simulate with streak tracking; streak B ⇒ fast-forward; zero window ⇒ rest unreachable.
Write final code: seed mask=1 at x=2, process segments/gaps in order, treat final gap specially to test N's reachability, print Yes/No.
Verify correctness on samples and edge cases; clean up dead code (`simulate_upto` unused) and confirm streak/mask invariants at gap transitions; fix any bugs.
Add cycle detection in `run_gap` (mask→position dict, period skip) to avoid O(N) when M=0 and A=B with N up to 1e12; re-verify samples and edge cases; produce final code.
